summary: BI-4150F4D6. Migration 20260812110000_backfill_missing_human_principals creates Principal(kind='human') + PrincipalAlias rows for existing User/EmployeeProfile records that lack them, because three human-creation paths omitted principal sync and the one-time April backfill is forward-only. This introduces NO new information: every value is re-projected from already-governed party records (User.email, EmployeeProfile.employeeId/userId/displayName/status, User.isSuperuser) into the canonical Principal identity spine — exactly what the runtime helpers (syncUserPrincipal/syncEmployeePrincipal) already do for new rows. Idempotent; inserts zero rows on an already-complete DB. The code paths are fixed in the same change so the gap does not recur.

fields.name: displayName
fields.reason: The human's display name, copied from the source EmployeeProfile.displayName (or User.email fallback). Governance is inherited from that party record; the backfill collects nothing new and creates no second home for the value.
fields.provenance: EmployeeProfile.displayName / User.email of the same install-local human. No external or new source.

fields.name: kind
fields.reason: Constant discriminator 'human' for the party class; not personal data.
fields.provenance: Literal in the migration, matching the runtime helpers.

fields.name: sensitivityClearance
fields.reason: Operational authorization clearance array. For superuser-linked principals the installation-owner floor (public/internal/confidential) is appended to mirror resolvePrincipalSensitivityClearance; not a data-subject attribute.
fields.provenance: Derived from User.isSuperuser of the linked account.

fields.name: aliasValue
fields.reason: Identifier bridging a Principal to its existing User/EmployeeProfile — the User id, the EmployeeProfile employeeId, or the lowercased email. Every value already exists on the source party record; the alias is a typed join, not new collection. Governance inherited from the source.
fields.provenance: User.id / EmployeeProfile.employeeId / User.email (lowercased) of the same install-local human.
